messages.text: BL-1635 🎵 in progress — The Android JVM unit suite is red on main - 4 of 275 BridgeClientTest cases fail with ComparisonFailure because the test's em-dash literals compiled into three replacement characters while production's compiled intact: the build's source charset follows whichever locale the JVM that compiled each source set happened to have (the acceptance handlers' Gradle lib launches with PATH and HOME only, JDK 17 derives file.encoding from the locale, gradle.properties pins UTF-8 for the Gradle JVM and nothing for the Kotlin compile daemon) - measured 2026-09-18, red for the five landed features that shell the suite (BL-829 4 scenarios, BL-825 0/6, BL-828 0/8, BL-769 2/4, BL-826 0/6); every JVM the build launches reads sources as UTF-8 regardless of locale, the handler lib exports an explicit UTF-8 locale, the raw NUL byte in BridgeClientTest.kt is escaped, the suite is 275/275, and the five rows leave in this land
